Find an appliance technician

Some jobs are not worth doing yourself. If the page you came from sent you here, it is because the likely fix involves a sealed system, mains wiring, a gas connection, or a part that costs more than half the price of replacing the machine.

Before you book

Have the model and serial number ready, usually on a sticker inside the door, behind the kick panel or on the back. Tell them the exact code and what you have already tried. A technician who arrives knowing the filter is already clear and the pump already spins freely will diagnose faster and charge you less.

What a call usually costs

In the United States, a diagnostic visit typically runs 80 to 150 dollars, often credited against the repair if you go ahead. A completed repair on a washer or dishwasher commonly lands between 150 and 400 dollars depending on the part. If the quote approaches half the cost of a new machine and the appliance is over eight years old, replacing is usually the better call.
